description: Eerste Constantijn Huygensstraat 108-116 (1873-74): orange-red brick, three axes on 6.4-7.0 m, a raised ground storey over souterrain lights with a stoop to a tall door with a fanlight on an outer axis, tall two-light segmental-headed windows in white frames, a white stone balcony with balusters on two consoles over the centre ground window, a white bracketed entablature (consoles over every pier), a slate mansard with one white pediment dormer on the centre axis.
